offering_description.value: Viasat provides satellite internet and communications to airlines, ship operators, businesses, households, and governments. It operates satellite and ground networks to deliver connectivity and builds communications and encryption equipment for commercial and defense customers.

primary_products.value: satellite terminals; antennas; modems; encryption equipment; military communications systems

primary_services.value: in-flight connectivity; maritime connectivity and safety communications; fixed satellite broadband; managed enterprise and government networks; secure military communications

customer_segment.value: B2B: Airlines, aircraft operators, shipping companies, and enterprises with remote sites; B2G: Military, intelligence, and civilian government agencies; B2C: Households in areas with limited terrestrial broadband

end_markets.value: aviation; maritime; residential broadband; enterprise connectivity; defense and government

revenue_model.value: service fees: Connectivity and managed networks for aircraft, ships, businesses, and public agencies; subscription: Monthly residential and business satellite internet plans; project or contract: Government and defense communications system development, integration, and operation; product sales: Satellite terminals, network hardware, and secure communications equipment
revenue_model.category: service fees; subscription; project or contract; product sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Operates satellites and ground stations to provide network capacity to commercial and government customers; service provider: Combines satellite capacity, terminals, and network management to deliver connectivity to businesses, households, and agencies; OEM / manufacturer: Integrates antenna, radio, and encryption components into communications equipment for commercial and defense customers
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; service provider; OEM / manufacturer

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: Aviation and maritime connectivity, fixed broadband, managed government networks, and secure communications equipment

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving airlines, fleet operators, enterprises, and government procurement programs; partners / resellers: Aviation equipment integrators, maritime service providers, and satellite service resellers; distributors / dealers: Local satellite internet dealers and installation providers; online: Company website for ordering residential satellite internet
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; partners / resellers; distributors / dealers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FCC and foreign regulators license satellite spectrum and earth stations, and export controls govern sensitive defense equipment.
